name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 50 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2026-06-15, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
